g.text: 09 Local deployment, responsibilities and design boundaries
The application runs on one Mac. Python handles deterministic mechanics; the local LLM handles claim interpretation, tool choice and semantic judgment.
UI session state holds run results.
CLI / evaluation bypass the API layer.
No model call for search or arithmetic.
Shared client used by both agents
documents.py / ingestion.py: manifest, PDF parse, fingerprints, index
memory.py: validate / recall / persist source evidence
evaluate.py: 20 × 3 benchmark and accuracy / usage accounting
api_evaluate.py: additional native HTTP / SSE checks
main.py / cli.py / workflow.py: command-line entry points
tests/: contracts, faults, budgets, source checks and reviewer tests
MERMAID: Decomposer + Executor + Toolset + Memory retained.
Web retrieval → fixed official PDFs; MCP tools → Python registry.
Full graph decomposition → one compact typed claim plan.
Lexical BM25 / FTS5; no embeddings or semantic reranking.
No OCR, durable graph checkpoint, or independent compound splitting.
Page-neighbour reads help table continuity; not a full table engine.
Source quotations establish provenance; final meaning remains model-dependent.
Run API: python -m uvicorn filing_checker.api:app | UI: python -m streamlit run streamlit_app.py | Ollama must be running with qwen3.5:9b installed.
